symbols.name: forall
symbols.lean_meaning: Universal quantification with explicit ordered dependent declarations.

symbols.name: exists
symbols.lean_meaning: Existential quantification with explicit ordered dependent declarations.

symbols.name: type
symbols.lean_meaning: One exact dependent binder sort annotation; not a term.

symbols.name: CommRing
symbols.lean_meaning: A type R equipped with CommRing R; no implicit domain or Noetherian hypothesis.

symbols.name: LocalRing
symbols.lean_meaning: A type R equipped with CommRing R and IsLocalRing R; locality is part of the bound structure.

symbols.name: Module
symbols.lean_meaning: An additive commutative group M with Module R M; declaration names its exact carrier.

symbols.name: Ideal
symbols.lean_meaning: Ideal R.

symbols.name: Submodule
symbols.lean_meaning: Submodule R M; M may be an explicitly constructed quotient or tensor carrier.

symbols.name: LinearMap
symbols.lean_meaning: M →ₗ[R] N with exact source and target carriers.

symbols.name: ideal_bot
symbols.lean_meaning: (⊥ : Ideal R).

symbols.name: maximal_ideal
symbols.lean_meaning: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R; rejected for a mere CommRing binder.

symbols.name: ideal_jacobson
symbols.lean_meaning: Ideal.jacobson I, the intersection of maximal ideals containing I.

symbols.name: ideal_le
symbols.lean_meaning: I ≤ J.

symbols.name: quotient
symbols.lean_meaning: M ⧸ U. Carrier identity retains exact R, M and U; quotient by a different submodule is a different carrier.

symbols.name: submodule_carrier
symbols.lean_meaning: The subtype U with its induced additive group and R-module structure.

symbols.name: tensor
symbols.lean_meaning: TensorProduct R M N with ordered factor carriers; no implicit commutativity coercion of factors.

symbols.name: submodule_bot
symbols.lean_meaning: (⊥ : Submodule R M).

symbols.name: submodule_top
symbols.lean_meaning: (⊤ : Submodule R M).

symbols.name: submodule_le
symbols.lean_meaning: U ≤ V.

symbols.name: submodule_sup
symbols.lean_meaning: U ⊔ V, the submodule sum.

symbols.name: submodule_inf
symbols.lean_meaning: U ⊓ V, the submodule intersection.

symbols.name: finite
symbols.lean_meaning: Module.Finite R M: finitely generated as an R-module, NOT finite cardinality.

symbols.name: fg
symbols.lean_meaning: U.FG: a finite subset spans U as an R-submodule of M.

symbols.name: flat
symbols.lean_meaning: Module.Flat R M: tensoring with M preserves injections of R-modules; no freeness or finite generation implied.

symbols.name: module_zero
symbols.lean_meaning: Subsingleton M, equivalently (⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊥; not a judgment about cardinality of generators.

symbols.name: ideal_smul
symbols.lean_meaning: I • U, generated by scalar products r • u with r in I and u in U. I • top denotes IM, not pointwise multiplication by one scalar.

symbols.name: quotient_map
symbols.lean_meaning: U.mkQ, the canonical linear quotient projection.

symbols.name: inclusion
symbols.lean_meaning: U.subtype, the canonical injective inclusion.

symbols.name: linear_id
symbols.lean_meaning: LinearMap.id.

symbols.name: kernel
symbols.lean_meaning: LinearMap.ker f.

symbols.name: range
symbols.lean_meaning: LinearMap.range f.

symbols.name: injective
symbols.lean_meaning: Function.Injective f.

symbols.name: surjective
symbols.lean_meaning: Function.Surjective f.

symbols.name: compose
symbols.lean_meaning: g.comp f; arguments are FIRST f THEN g, not Lean comp receiver order.

symbols.name: exact
symbols.lean_meaning: Function.Exact f g, equivalent to LinearMap.range f = LinearMap.ker g. No endpoint injectivity or surjectivity implied.

symbols.name: map
symbols.lean_meaning: U.map f.

symbols.name: comap
symbols.lean_meaning: V.comap f.

symbols.name: tensor_map_left
symbols.lean_meaning: f.lTensor X = identity_X ⊗ f. The fixed factor X comes before the source M and target N.

symbols.name: and
symbols.lean_meaning: Logical conjunction.

symbols.name: or
symbols.lean_meaning: Logical disjunction.

symbols.name: implies
symbols.lean_meaning: Logical implication from first to second argument.

symbols.name: not
symbols.lean_meaning: Logical negation.

symbols.name: eq
symbols.signature: (a:T,b:T)->Prop, T is an ideal, submodule or linear-map sort
symbols.lean_meaning: a = b

symbols.name: neq
symbols.signature: (a:T,b:T)->Prop, T is an ideal, submodule or linear-map sort
symbols.lean_meaning: a ≠ b

symbols.name: Submonoid
symbols.lean_meaning: Submonoid R; a multiplicative subset containing 1, possibly containing 0.

symbols.name: noetherian
symbols.lean_meaning: IsNoetherian R M: every ascending submodule chain stabilizes.

symbols.name: artinian
symbols.lean_meaning: IsArtinian R M: every descending submodule chain stabilizes.

symbols.name: finite_length
symbols.lean_meaning: IsFiniteLength R M; finite composition length, not finite underlying set.

symbols.name: scalar_module
symbols.lean_meaning: R with its regular R-module structure.

symbols.name: product
symbols.lean_meaning: M × N with componentwise R-module structure.

symbols.name: hom
symbols.lean_meaning: M →ₗ[R] N with pointwise R-module structure.

symbols.name: localized_module
symbols.lean_meaning: LocalizedModule S M, regarded as an R-module by restricting scalars, not as a new bound independent module.

symbols.name: localization_map
symbols.lean_meaning: LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M; x ↦ x/1.

symbols.name: localized_map
symbols.lean_meaning: IsLocalizedModule.map S (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M) (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S N) f; x/s ↦ f(x)/s.

symbols.name: localized_submodule
symbols.lean_meaning: U.localized₀ S (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M); fractions x/s with x∈U, viewed over R. Usually larger than the image of U under x↦x/1.

symbols.name: hom_precompose
symbols.lean_meaning: LinearMap.lcomp R P f; h ↦ h.comp f, contravariant in the first Hom argument.

symbols.name: hom_postcompose
symbols.lean_meaning: LinearMap.llcomp R M N P f; h ↦ f.comp h, covariant in the second Hom argument.

symbols.name: tensor_lift
symbols.lean_meaning: TensorProduct.lift b; unique linear map with x⊗y ↦ b x y.

symbols.name: tensor_curry
symbols.lean_meaning: TensorProduct.curry f; x ↦ (y ↦ f (x⊗y)).

symbols.name: bilinear_postcompose
symbols.lean_meaning: b.compr₂ g; (x,y) ↦ g (b x y).

symbols.name: tensor_comm
symbols.lean_meaning: (TensorProduct.comm R M N).toLinearMap; x⊗y ↦ y⊗x.

symbols.name: tensor_assoc
symbols.lean_meaning: (TensorProduct.assoc R M N P).toLinearMap; (x⊗y)⊗z ↦ x⊗(y⊗z).
